overall_verdict: FAIL (blockers open) - 3 blocker-level problems found; not clear for final delivery as-is. Most of the reel is strong; failures are localized to S6 lens-facing/talking-mouth risk, S8 stomach front-facing open mouth, and the S9 garbled brand sub-line.

blockers_failed.evidence: The gold tagline 'पेट हल्का। दिन हल्का।' renders correctly. BUT the grey brand sub-line meant to read 'आयुर्वेदिक  •  BLUMELIFE' has a BROKEN Devanagari word: 'आयुर्वेदिक' renders with U+25CC dotted-circle placeholders and a split conjunct, showing as 'आ यु ◌र् ◌ वे ◌ द ि क' - the 'र्व' half-form conjunct and the 'दि' matra failed to shape (font/libass fallback shaping failure on the ffmpeg burn). This is garbled Devanagari -> fails 'correct Devanagari, no typo'. BLUMELIFE (Latin) is clean.
blockers_failed.fix: Re-burn card.ass with a font that shapes Devanagari conjuncts (Nirmala UI is installed but the burn fell back to a non-shaping path; force fontsdir + correct fontname, or harfbuzz shaping). Simplest: drop 'आयुर्वेदिक' from the grey line and keep '• BLUMELIFE Clear Gut' (Latin) if Devanagari shaping can't be guaranteed.

blockers_failed.evidence: Rubric requires NO hero faces the lens directly (so Veo has no front-facing mouth to animate). Amla (front-left) is clearly lens-facing with an OPEN mouth showing teeth/tongue; Ajwain is also near-front. Saunf and Haritaki read more in profile. Front-facing mouths ARE available -> the no-lens-mouths guard is not satisfied.
blockers_failed.fix: If S6-no-talking-mouths is confirmed clean by the human, this can be Director-accepted (mouths available but not talking). Otherwise re-key S6 with all four heroes in true profile.

blockers_failed.evidence: Rubric requires the stomach in three-quarter profile with face/mouth turned AWAY from the lens. Body is three-quarter, BUT the face/eyes and an OPEN smiling mouth are clearly angled toward the lens and visible (mouth open with teeth in s055/s057). 'Turned away from lens' is not met.

needs_human.evidence: Video analysis described the stomach 'gestures toward the bottle, brings hands to belly' and a 'wide smiling mouth' but did NOT report lip-sync-to-speech (contrast: S2/S4/S5 analyses explicitly said 'mouth moves in sync'). HOWEVER the stomach's mouth is front-facing, open, and changes shape across s055->s057->s059. Frame+analysis cannot prove the mouth is NOT talking under the narrator VO. A human must watch S8 (53-61s) and confirm the stomach mouth does not articulate the narration. If it does, this is a hard blocker (second talking mouth under VO).

Video analysis of S6 described stomach eyes opening/smiling and herbs flexing, with NO description of any character speaking (the line is narrator VO). But Amla's lens-facing open mouth means a human must confirm on playback that no hero's mouth articulates the VO. Lean pass, confirm by ear/eye.

Analysis: King 'facial features move as if speaking'; the shadow-stomach is back-to-camera in scene 1 and absent from later frames -> no second mouth. Strongly leans pass; human confirms the shadow-stomach never grows a moving mouth.

UTMOS is English-TTS-trained; absolute Hindi scores read low. Only S3 (1.46) flagged as relative low outlier (>=0.3 below median 1.83). Human should listen to S3 (Ajwain, 15.2-22.8s) to confirm it is acceptable; S7 highest (2.66).

Karaoke .ass is generated from the KNOWN Devanagari script (make_karaoke.py KNOWN dict), not OCR/transliteration, and burned frames render correct gold Devanagari (s011/s019/s033 etc.). Caption layer shaping is fine (unlike the S9 card sub-line). Human should diff one readable frame per scene vs script for matra/conjunct exactness.
Karaoke fill timing vs spoken words needs playback to confirm; .ass uses per-word \kf weights from whisper word spans. Human confirms on playback.

Video analysis confirms mouths move while speaking for S2/S4/S5 ('mouth moves in sync'); S1 King 'features move as if speaking'; S3 talks with expressive face. Qualitative sync good. Frame-exact offset (>~150ms) is the only remaining human check.
Analysis explicitly gendered Saunf 'She/her' (long lashes, feminine). Voice gender best confirmed by human ear, but visual + the model's own read support female.

voice_mos.rule: flag if >=0.3 below median; UTMOS English-trained -> relative only, no absolute threshold
